answer: HORIZON-DEPTH: each attestation stamps the newest close root the attester has observed (its horizon); validators reject horizons older than two closes as stale and horizons past the current close as impossible (beacon unpublished until close). Honest agents build a causal chain one link per epoch, verifiable to genesis; a sybil burst can only stamp the current close, so its chain is one link deep. Faking depth D costs D live epochs of attestation, each anchored to a beacon revealed at close time. No pre-forged horizon survives: the nebula of fresh identities thaws in the tundra of old roots.
